name: Bardot Plastics
old_description: Three generations of expertise delivering precision parts since 1973. Our modern facility with state-of-the-art equipment ensures quality at every step.
about:
Bardot Plastics operates from a modern facility in Easton, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1973 by J. Lee Boucher, the company began as a vision to provide superior injection molding services and has since grown into a third-generation, family-owned business now led by Chris, Jim, and Rick Boucher.

The company specializes in high-tonnage injection molding, with presses up to 1,760 tons capable of producing large, complex parts that many molders cannot accommodate. Its full-service offering spans design consultation, integrated tooling (single-cavity, multi-cavity, and family molds), insert molding, sonic welding, in-house assembly, packaging, and fulfillment. A 120-ton central chilling unit and advanced robotics support consistent quality across runs.

Bardot serves a diverse industrial base including office furniture, lawn and garden, waste and recycling, industrial equipment, military, construction, agricultural, and commercial markets. Customers range from OEMs requiring precision components to brands needing durable, weather-resistant parts for outdoor and heavy-duty applications.

The founding mantra “making it right the first time” drives the operation, guided by principles of excellence, innovation, sustainability, and partnership. The company differentiates itself through large-tonnage capacity, end-to-end single-source solutions, dedicated project managers, and continuous investment in technology such as the recent chilling unit installation.
